desktop.sidebar: 252 wide, 900 tall at x0; padding 0 15px; nav block padding 22px 22px 0 0
desktop.columnTitle: h1 20px/25px w600 at (417,22); header block padding 10px 24px 8px; sticky header 640x72
desktop.feedColumn: 640 wide at x393, 5795 tall; 1px inline --border; centered in the viewport
desktop.avatar: 36x36 circle at (418,165); 48px column including the 12px gutter
desktop.authorRow: 15px/21px at y161; handle w600 --foreground; time w400 --ink-subtle; row gap 6px
desktop.body: 15px/21px w400 --foreground, starts y185 (3px under the author row)
desktop.actionRow: 550x36 at (458,660), 8px left of the content inset; buttons 50/42/53/44 wide; gap 8px; icons 18-19px (--icon-size); counts 13px/18.2px --ink-soft
desktop.hairline: --hairline 1px, 638 wide, above each row at y148

mobile.header: fixed 390x60, --background at 85% alpha, wordmark 32x32 centered, 24x24 icon buttons at x12 and x341

canvas.note: post rows are transparent on the canvas; only --hairline separates them

elevated.note: menu panel 240 wide, --radius-panel, section fill --card, 1px --hairline between sections

columnBorder.note: 1px inline border on the feed column; the sidebar has no border against the canvas

hairline.note: row divider above each post; --hairline-width is 1px

navItem.note: hover and current-row fills only; no accent bar, no text color change, active label w600

inkLadder.note: body and handle are --foreground; counts are --ink-soft; time and index badge are --ink-subtle. Measured values live in SOURCE.md.

status.note: link and secondary user names use --status-info; the logout row uses --status-danger. Measured values live in SOURCE.md.

notMeasured: linear's mid-weight heading role (15/23/500) — threads exposes only 400 and 600 weights
light menu fill and separator — derived from --popover / --border
--panel-fold-duration/ease — threads has no measured card fold; borrowed from linear
right discover column (the live home feed has none; plan §3 adds it)
captures: {designDir}/ref/threads.com/ — desktop home light/dark, desktop home menu, mobile home dark; PNGs + pages/home.mhtml + index.json
